name: kb_381_Normalized

schema.description: Represents a Glusterfs mount that lasts the lifetime of a pod. Glusterfs volumes do not support ownership management or SELinux relabeling.

endpoints.description: EndpointsName is the endpoint name that details Glusterfs topology. More info: https://examples.k8s.io/volumes/glusterfs/README.md#create-a-pod

path.description: Path is the Glusterfs volume path. More info: https://examples.k8s.io/volumes/glusterfs/README.md#create-a-pod

readOnly.description: ReadOnly here will force the Glusterfs volume to be mounted with read-only permissions. Defaults to false. More info: https://examples.k8s.io/volumes/glusterfs/README.md#create-a-pod

description: The pod is configured to use a GlusterFS volume that connects through the endpoint named **gluster‑cluster**. The volume’s data is accessed at the path **/data/vol1** on the GlusterFS server. Since the mount is intended for read‑write access, the `readOnly` flag is set to **false**, allowing the application inside the pod to modify files as needed.
